title: Revealing Geometry under Strong Noise: Spectral Embeddings and Clustering via Random Geometric Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.31047v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern massive datasets often contain useful low-dimensional nonlinear structures that are hidden by noise. Spectral embedding algorithms rely on meaningful local relationships between observations, but noise accumulated across many coordinates can make the observed distances unreliable. This also complicates clustering when groups have curved or concentric shapes and cannot be distinguished by their centers. In this paper, we develop a new method that denoises pairwise distances before using them to construct spectral embeddings and identify communities. Our approach uses cross-fitted projections to estimate distances between the underlying signals, selects a neighborhood radius from the observed sample, and builds a random geometric graph whose spectral coordinates represent the latent geometric structure. translated_title: 强噪声下的几何揭示：基于随机几何图的谱嵌入与聚类
translated_abstract: 现代大规模数据集通常包含有用的低维非线性结构，但这些结构往往被噪声所掩盖。谱嵌入算法依赖于观测之间有意义的局部关系，然而跨越多个坐标累积的噪声会使观测到的距离变得不可靠。当数据群体具有弯曲或同心形状、无法通过其中心加以区分时，这也使聚类问题变得更加复杂。在本文中，我们提出了一种新方法，在使用成对距离构建谱嵌入和识别社区之前对其进行去噪。我们的方法使用交叉拟合投影来估计底层信号之间的距离，从观测样本中选取邻域半径，并构建一个随机几何图，其谱坐标代表了潜在的几何结构。通过连接邻近的点，这种几何图即使在各群体中心重合的情况下也能区分不同的群体。一种新颖的递归（recu...）方法...
tldr: 本文提出一种先对成对距离去噪再构建随机几何图进行谱嵌入与聚类的新方法，即使在强噪声和群体中心重合（如同心形状）的情况下也能有效揭示数据的潜在低维几何结构并区分不同群体。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new method that denoises pairwise distances before constructing spectral embeddings and clustering via random geometric graphs, effectively revealing latent low-dimensional geometry and distinguishing groups even under strong noise and coinciding centers.
